environment.description: Amazon Linux 2 EC2 instance running the SQS consumer as a systemd service under the 'acme-worker' user. SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0 was set during initial deployment troubleshooting and never reverted). The worker process runs with uid=1001 (acme-worker) which has write access to /var/log/acme-worker/ and /etc/acme-worker/ but the filesystem permissions on sensitive paths like /etc/cron.d/, /etc/shadow are world-writable due to a misconfigured AMI base image. No AppArmor or other MAC policy is active.
